rationale: The Court is likely to issue a narrow, avoidance-tinged statutory holding that FSIA § 1330(b) supplies personal jurisdiction over a foreign state when an immunity exception applies and service is proper under § 1608, without layering on a minimum-contacts requirement. Separate writings are most likely to press (or cabin) the unresolved Fifth Amendment “personhood” question and to flag potential distinctions for agencies/instrumentalities or other future cases.
